about.title: ABOUT ME
about.heading: I like the invisible parts.
paragraphs: I'm a backend engineer. I design the APIs, data models and plumbing that apps run on, and I care about the unglamorous stuff: clear contracts, correct data and systems that stay up.

I've built backends for mobile apps, wired IoT sensors to live dashboards, and shipped in Python and C#. When something works but nobody can explain why, I want to know. Lately I'm putting GenAI to work on the tedious parts of my own workflow.

list.title: Us
list.description: A private corner of the internet for two. Share moods, leave notes that unlock later, and keep your story in one place, however many kilometres apart.

list.title: CloudSense
list.description: ESP32 sensors talk MQTT to the cloud, and a React dashboard shows every reading the moment it lands.

list.title: Songbook
